format:

    code-fold: true
    code-tools: true
    embed-resources: true
params:
  areas: barcelona
  from: "2020-09-01"
  to: "2020-12-31"
  K: 6
  set: refinements
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

PSIS-LOO leaves out one ABS-day at a time. A weekly time effect is then still informed by the other days of the same
week, which favours it. Here whole weeks are left out: week w goes to fold (w - 1) mod `r params$K` + 1, so each fold
holds out weeks spread over the period, for all ABS at once. Each variant is fitted once per fold with
`stan/spacetime.stan` (the held-out ABS-days are left out of the likelihood), and the held-out ABS-days are scored by
their log predictive density. All variants use the same folds, so their differences are paired.

Two limits: the cases of a held-out week still enter the lagged pressures of the following weeks, as observed history
(the model conditions on past counts); and with linear interpolation between week midpoints, the days next to a
held-out week still inform its knot a little.

Each fold fit is cached in `outputs/cv/`, so a render resumes where the last one stopped. Barcelona, per fold fit:
about 3 minutes (time0, time1), 8-9 (time2, time3), 14 (negative binomial); 6 folds per variant, about 5-6 hours in
all. The results section uses the variants with all folds done, so a partial run can be rendered. Render from
`end-epi/slater`.

```{r}
#| label: setup
suppressMessages({library(rstan); library(ggplot2)})
stopifnot("run from end-epi/slater" = file.exists("helpers.R"))
if (!isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))) params = rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter("6_cv.qmd")$params
source("helpers.R")
window_key = paste(params$areas, params$from, params$to, sep = "_")
dir.create(out("cv"), showWarnings = FALSE)
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12) + theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "top"))
variants = CV_SETS[[params$set]]
names(variants)
```

## Fits

Set `fit_now = FALSE` to skip fitting and only summarise the folds already done, e.g. after a PALMA run
(`palma/prepare_cv.R`, `palma/cv.sbatch`, then `bash palma/fetch_cv.sh`), which writes the same fold files.

```{r}
#| label: fits
fit_now = TRUE
f_inputs = out(paste0("daily_", window_key, "_inputs.rds"))
d = if (file.exists(f_inputs)) readRDS(f_inputs) else daily_inputs(params$areas, as.Date(params$from), as.Date(params$to))
if (!file.exists(f_inputs)) saveRDS(d, f_inputs)
model = rstan::stan_model("stan/spacetime.stan")
scheme = CV_SCHEME[[params$set]]
fold_file = \(v, k) cv_fold_file(window_key, v, k, params$K, scheme)
for (v in names(variants)) for (k in seq_len(params$K)) {
	if (!fit_now || file.exists(fold_file(v, k))) next
	holdout = cv_holdout(scheme, nrow(d$cases), ncol(d$cases), k, params$K)
	fit = rstan::sampling(model, data = spacetime_data(d, variants[[v]], holdout), iter = 1000, warmup = 500, chains = 4,
		cores = 4, refresh = 0, pars = "log_lik")
	held = which(holdout == 1)
	ll = matrix(rstan::extract(fit, "log_lik")[[1]], ncol = length(d$cases))[, held]
	saveRDS(list(cell = held, elpd = lpd(ll), divergent = rstan::get_num_divergent(fit),
		max_rhat = max(rstan::summary(fit)$summary[, "Rhat"], na.rm = TRUE)), fold_file(v, k))
	cat(v, "fold", k, "done\n")
}
```

## Results

Sum of the held-out log predictive densities over all ABS-days (higher is better), with the standard error of each
variant's difference from the best, from the paired pointwise differences.

```{r}
#| label: results
done = names(variants)[vapply(names(variants), \(v) all(file.exists(fold_file(v, seq_len(params$K)))), logical(1))]
stopifnot("no variant has all folds done" = length(done) > 0)
folds = lapply(setNames(done, done), \(v) lapply(seq_len(params$K), \(k) readRDS(fold_file(v, k))))
pointwise = sapply(folds, \(f) {x = unlist(lapply(f, `[[`, "elpd")); x[order(unlist(lapply(f, `[[`, "cell")))]})
best = which.max(colSums(pointwise))
data.frame(elpd = colSums(pointwise), elpd_diff = colSums(pointwise) - sum(pointwise[, best]),
	se_diff = apply(pointwise - pointwise[, best], 2, \(x) sqrt(length(x)) * sd(x)),
	divergent = sapply(folds, \(f) sum(sapply(f, `[[`, "divergent"))),
	max_rhat = sapply(folds, \(f) max(sapply(f, `[[`, "max_rhat")))) |>
	(\(x) x[order(-x$elpd), ])() |> round(2)
```

By fold, relative to the model in use (`BASELINE`, the first variant): a refinement that wins only in some folds is
fitting particular weeks.

```{r}
#| label: by-fold
#| fig-height: 4
by_fold = sapply(folds, \(f) sapply(f, \(x) sum(x$elpd)))
reference = if (names(variants)[1] %in% done) names(variants)[1] else done[1]
data.frame(fold = rep(seq_len(params$K), ncol(by_fold)), variant = rep(colnames(by_fold), each = params$K),
	diff = c(by_fold - by_fold[, reference])) |>
	ggplot(aes(factor(fold), diff, colour = variant, group = variant)) +
	geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = 2) +
	geom_point() + geom_line() +
	labs(x = "Fold", y = paste("Held-out log density minus", reference), colour = NULL)
```
